{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Show distribution of sample_seq per patient

print(f'Distribution of sample_seq per patient: {Counter(sample_seq_counts)}')"}
